scares.description: When Father Peter reaches his hand out to the person standing in the corner it turns around with a loud scream.
When Father Peter turns around the person is standing right in front of him and attacks him with a scream
A bloody hand is smashing on the window in the door
Hands coming out of the pillow and grabbing Peter
The Jesus-like apparition is sitting on Peter and screams
Sister Camila is pulled back into the dark by an unseen force
Dr. Nelson is attacked by a possessed woman
